title: Dave Eggers told OpenAI staff  that ChatGPT was ‘silencing an entire generation’
brief: Author Dave Eggers told OpenAI staff that ChatGPT is "silencing an entire generation" and having a "catastrophic" effect on educators and writers. Eggers, invited by Sam Altman to speak to roughly 200 employees, criticized the company for disrupting teaching and creative work despite potentially unintentional consequences.
